thread:
marie: Heads-up — PR #4234 is ready for final review: migration guide + SDK snippets. Docs preview failed with a broken relative link and the term-lint checker flagged a couple of voice issues. Need one more reviewer and a preferred merge window (leaning late-night PDT).
ben: Looking now. which snippets are out of parity?
sasha: term-lint: flagged 'customers' -> prefer 'users' in how-to docs; and 'we' vs 'you' inconsistencies in the Quickstart section.
ben: Found two issues: python snippet uses the old SDK call `client.generate_text(...)` while TS uses `client.text.generate(...)`. I'll align them. Also the python snippet prints the full Response object — better to show just `resp.text` to keep examples concise.
ben: (code)
```
# python
resp = client.text.generate("Write a haiku about GPUs")
print(resp.output_text)
```
sasha: Nice — shorter output is easier to copy. Also change headings: 'Quickstart' -> 'Quick start' per style guide.
marie: Good catch. The broken link was from a relative include: `/migration/sdk/python.md` -> should be `../sdk/python.md`. docs-preview reported it in the render log.
docs-preview-bot: Preview failed for branch feature/migrate-snippets — render error: 404 on include path /migration/sdk/python.md at 1825009992. Log: https://ci.internal/reports/4234
ian: For voice: prefer imperative 'You' in procedural steps, keep 'we' in architectural context. Migration guide has a mix — suggest a short sweep to standardize.
ben: Pushed fixes: aligned TS/Python snippets, changed prints, fixed include path, and updated the heading. Commit 3c9f7b8. CI rerun queued.
docs-preview-bot: Rebuild triggered (1825010120) — running lint & preview.
marie: @sasha can you give a quick tone check once preview passes? planning to merge Thu 02:00 PDT if no objections. Want to avoid peak daytime merges.
sasha: Will check once preview is green. FYI small nit: use 'Quick start' as two words in TOC too.
ben: Preview link (temp): https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/4234 — looks rendered for me locally.
docs-preview-bot: Preview succeeded: deploy at https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/4234 at 1825010235. Lint: term-lint warnings cleared.
sasha: Reviewed live preview — tone/terminology fixed. LGTM.
marie: Thanks everyone — merging at Thu 02:00 PDT unless anyone objects.
ian: No objections from infra. Merge away. :rocket:
marie: Merged. closing thread.
